records.literal_gloss: And saw Israel the hand the great which had done Yahweh against Egypt, and feared the people Yahweh, and they believed in Yahweh and in Moses his servant.

en.L: And Israel saw the great hand that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done against Egypt, and the people feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they believed in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in Moses {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant.
en.B: Israel had seen the great hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at work against Egypt. So the people feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they believed in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in Moses, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant.
en.R: When the Israelites saw what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done to Egypt with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power, they were filled with awe before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They believed in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and in Moses, who served {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y vio Israel la gran mano que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mostrado contra Egipto, y el pueblo temió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y creyeron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y en Moisés, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo.
es.B: Israel había visto la gran mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} actuando contra Egipto. Por eso el pueblo temió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y creyó en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y en Moisés, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo.
es.R: Cuando los israelitas vieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho a Egipto con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder, se llenaron de reverencia ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Creyeron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y en Moisés, que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servía.

fr.L: Et Israël vit la grande main que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait déployée contre l’Égypte, et le peuple craignit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils crurent en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et en Moïse, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur.
fr.B: Israël avait vu la grande main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à l’œuvre contre l’Égypte. Alors le peuple craignit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il crut en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et en Moïse, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur.
fr.R: Quand les Israélites ont vu ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait à l’Égypte par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance, ils ont été remplis de respect devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont cru en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et en Moïse, qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servait.

sw.L: Nao Israeli wakauona ule mkono mkuu ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuonyesha juu ya Wamisri, nao watu wakamcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakamwamini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Israeli walikuwa wameuona mkono mkuu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukifanya kazi dhidi ya Misri. Kwa hiyo watu wakamcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakamwamini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Waisraeli walipoona yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatendea Wamisri kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu, walijawa na hofu ya heshima mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walimwamini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa, aliyemtumikia.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트에 행하신 큰 손을 보았다. 그래서 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하였고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 종 모세를 믿었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 큰 능력으로 이집트에 행하신 일을 보았다. 그러자 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하였고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 종 모세를 믿었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 큰 능력으로 이집트에 하신 일을 보았다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하며 공경하게 되었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿고, 그분을 섬기는 모세도 믿었다.

vi.L: Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy bàn tay lớn mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm để chống lại Ai Cập, và dân chúng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ tin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và tin Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Y-sơ-ra-ên đã thấy bàn tay quyền năng lớn lao của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hành động chống lại Ai Cập. Vì vậy dân chúng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ tin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và tin Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dùng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho Ai Cập, họ đầy lòng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ tin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và tin Môi-se, người phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: E Israel viu a grande mão que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha exercido contra o Egito, e o povo temeu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e creram {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} e em Moisés, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo.
pt.B: Israel tinha visto a grande mão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} agindo contra o Egito. Por isso o povo temeu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e creu {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} e em Moisés, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo.
pt.R: Os israelitas viram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito contra o Egito com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder, e ficaram cheios de reverência diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eles creram {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} e em Moisés, que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} servia.

am.L: እስራኤልም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በግብፃውያን ላይ ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን እጅ አየ፤ ሕዝቡም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፈሩ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} በባሪያው በሙሴ አመኑ።
am.B: እስራኤል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በግብፅ ላይ የሠራውን ታላቅ እጅ አይቶ ነበር። ስለዚህ ሕዝቡ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፈሩ፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} በአገልጋዩ በሙሴ አመኑ።
am.R: እስራኤላውያን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በታላቅ ኃይሉ በግብፅ ላይ ያደረገውን ባዩ ጊዜ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት በአክብሮት ፍርሃት ተሞሉ። {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔርና|በያህዌና}} እርሱን በሚያገለግለው በሙሴ አመኑ።

decisions.choice: the great hand: the great power and the mighty deed
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power, and here for what that power did. God had promised to bring Israel out with a strong hand (3:19-20; 6:1).

decisions.choice: feared Yahweh: stood in awe of him
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 10, where the people were afraid of the Egyptians. Now their fear is turned to Yahweh: reverence and awe at what he has done.

decisions.choice: they believed in Yahweh and in Moses his servant: the fear of 4:1 answered
decisions.reason: Moses feared the people would not believe him (4:1). They believed at the signs (4:31), lost heart under their labor (6:9), and now believe in Yahweh and in Moses. Moses is called Yahweh's servant again in Numbers 12:7 and Deuteronomy 34:5.

decisions.choice: the great hand of the LORD at work (Balanced); his great power (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the hand; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: were filled with awe before
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "feared" here, which is reverence, not terror. Literal and Balanced keep "feared".

decisions.choice: "경외하다" (L, B) for fearing Yahweh, with "믿다" kept at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this fear as awe; "경외하다" says that, and Readable unpacks it as "두려워하며 공경하다". "믿다" is kept at every level as in the Korean New Testament.

decisions.choice: o seu servo (every level)
decisions.reason: docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md gives "escravo" at Literal for the Hebrew word, but "servant of Yahweh" is a title of honor for Moses (m3), and the English keeps "servant" at Literal; so does the Portuguese.

decisions.choice: creram (every level)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "crer", as the English Readable keeps "believed": the people now trust Yahweh and Moses (m3), the answer to 4:1, 31.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያው" (L); "አገልጋዩ" (B); "እርሱን የሚያገለግለው" (R)
decisions.reason: Moses is the servant of Yahweh, an honoured title; the Pentateuch terms keep "ባሪያ" at Literal and "አገልጋይ" at Balanced and Readable, where "ባሪያ" would sound like slavery.
